description: Create or replace a file on the remote machine (content up to 1 MiB; atomic, mode kept). Prefer edit or multi_edit for changes to an existing file. On a guarded fleet you must first ask the user and get their explicit agreement; only then set `confirm` to the fleet name.

confirm.description: Guarded fleets only: the fleet name, set only after the user explicitly agreed. Never set it on your own.

content.description: The complete new file content (at most 1 MiB; use upload for more). Replaces the file.

context.description: Context name. Omit to use the default.

fleet.description: Fleet name. Omit to use the default.

mode.description: Permission bits for a new file (decimal, e.g. 420 for 0644).

path.description: File path on the remote machine: absolute, or relative to the workspace directory.

workspace.description: Workspace id. Omit to use this session's workspace on the fleet.

name: write
